test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I ate / the egg / yesterday for / my dinner.
solution:
The correct answer is "**the egg.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, **the error lies in the usage of the article "the."**
 
• The correct article to use before the noun "egg" is "an."
 
• "An" is used before a singular noun beginning with a vowel sound.
 
 
• Example: An apple, an animal, etc.
 
 
 
• **In the given sentence, the singular noun "egg" also starts with a vowel sound. Thus it will be preceded by article "an."**
 
• It should be "I ate an egg yesterday for my dinner." 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The subject-verb agreement in the sentence is correct.
 
• The time adverb "yesterday" is in the correct position. 
 
• The preposition "for" is also correctly used.
